entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: 'or' between a float-valued and a histogram-valued operand does not support a %s-shaped float operand, which cerberus issue #2333 does not cover
entries.rationale: both callers (lowerMixedExpHistogramSetOp, and — since cerberus issue #2453 — lowerSumOrAvgOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp) reach this default switch arm only when RowShapeOf(floatNode) is neither SampleRowShape, GridWindowRowShape, nor ReducedWindowRowShape, i.e. HistogramRowShape or MixedRowShape — believed unreachable through any parseable query today, since the float side already failed isExpHistogramValuedShape before lower() is called on it. A defensive guard against a future histogram-aware float lowering silently mis-projecting through this path, not a live divergence.

guard: default of switch shape over [case chplan.SampleRowShape, chplan.GridWindowRowShape, chplan.ReducedWindowRowShape; default]
